user.title: Log in at Albert Heijn
user.description:
1. Open [the AH login page]({login_url}) in a desktop browser and open the developer tools (F12) on the **Console** tab.
2. Log in. The last page will not load: it redirects to the AH app.
3. Copy the line `Failed to launch 'appie://login-exit?code=…'` from the console (Firefox: copy the `appie://` address) and paste it below. The code is only valid for a few minutes.

data_description.redirect_url: The whole line or URL is fine; only the code is used.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in at Albert Heijn again
reauth_confirm.description:
The AH login has expired.

1. Open [the AH login page]({login_url}) in a desktop browser and open the developer tools (F12) on the **Console** tab.
2. Log in. The last page will not load: it redirects to the AH app.
3. Copy the line `Failed to launch 'appie://login-exit?code=…'` from the console (Firefox: copy the `appie://` address) and paste it below.

data_description.redirect_url: The whole line or URL is fine; only the code is used.

error.invalid_code: No login code found in what you pasted.
error.invalid_auth: AH rejected the code. Codes expire after a few minutes and work only once: log in again for a fresh one.

abort.already_configured: This AH account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: You logged in with a different AH account than the one set up.

auth_failed.message: The AH login has expired. Log in again via the repair notification.

add_item.name: Add item to AH list

alternatives.name: Alternatives
alternatives.description: Other names to try for a product. Mealie aliases as returned by mealie.get_shopping_list_items work as they are.
